summary: Mito City's official open-data publication evidences a local cadastral-map custodian and a downloadable parcel-number map package, but the ZIP could not be inspected in this environment. No geometry sample is retained and runtime readiness remains held.
custodian: Mito City Taxation Division, fixed-assets tax section (水戸市資産税課資産税係). Ibaraki Digital Map is a secondary shared GIS lead.
requests: English and Japanese first-party discovery, official page GETs, official ZIP-link resolution, and a bounded archive retrieval attempt are recorded in the city record. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe-field request, or TLS exception was used.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
full parcel polygon geometry only when safely returned
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [36.3661416094041, 140.450204762994] and population 189060 persons are preserved.
The city warns the published map is approximate and cannot be used for boundaries, area calculation, registration, or rights confirmation.
Download failure and lack of an exposed API were not treated as citywide absence.
No unsafe land-record fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: Native IDs, CRS, actual geometry, and coverage remain unverified because the advertised ZIP was not retrievable for inspection.
